_approach: Peak-time-techno-derived kit: sharp offbeat closed hats, a soft ride in 8ths, a rolling 16th shaker with a 4-step accent contour and a tight clap on 2 and 4 - clean and punchy rather than rumbly, which is what separates hypertechno drums from hard techno's distortion stack. Reference: Beatport 'Techno (Peak Time / Driving)' hypertechno crossovers, HBz. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
